journalRequirements: A writing kit with brushes, palette and ink.
The dry desert beyond the fertile Nile land.
Along the Nile banks and fertile delta.
The video says nearly 4,000 miles; an approximation.
What were ditches and canals used for?
To retain floodwater and direct it to fields.
They observed the Moon and stars and developed a calendar.
When was ancient Egypt's new year?
The video links it to flood onset and Sirius; calendars drifted over time.
Barley, wheat, flax, vegetables and fruits.
A trained reader, writer and record keeper.
Egyptian signs used for formal and religious writing; signs convey sounds and meanings.
A Nile wetland plant, also made into writing material.
Food, boats, fuel, sandals and writing scrolls.
Gods; animal forms represented particular deities.
Narmer in this video; Menes is a traditional first-king name with uncertain identification.
What were the two kingdoms along the Nile?
Upper Egypt is south near Thebes: true or false?
Narmer did not unify Upper and Lower Egypt: true or false?
False in the video: Narmer united the kingdoms.
